mapper.select: SELECT dws_pgl.id, 0 user_type, q.dates, q.pkg, q.game_level, q.user_num, q.record_count, q.avg_record_count, q.pass_user_num, q.pass_rate, q.fail_user_num, q.fail_rate FROM (SELECT dgrd.dates, dgrd.pkg, dgrd.game_level, COUNT(DISTINCT dgrd.user_id) user_num, COUNT(dgrd.user_id) record_count, COUNT(dgrd.user_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT dgrd.user_id) avg_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE dgrd.game_status WHEN 1 THEN dgrd.user_id END)) pass_user_num, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE dgrd.game_status WHEN 1 THEN dgrd.user_id END)) / COUNT(DISTINCT dgrd.user_id), 8) pass_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT dgrd.user_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE dgrd.game_status WHEN 1 THEN dgrd.user_id END)) fail_user_num, (1 - ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE dgrd.game_status WHEN 1 THEN dgrd.user_id END)) / COUNT(DISTINCT dgrd.user_id), 8)) fail_rate FROM dwd_user_game_record dgrd WHERE dgrd.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dgrd.dates, dgrd.pkg, dgrd.game_level) q LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_game_level dws_pgl ON (dws_pgl.dates = q.dates and dws_pgl.pkg = q.pkg and dws_pgl.game_level = q.game_level)

SELECT dws_pgl.id, 1 user_type, q.dates, q.pkg, q.game_level, q.user_num, q.record_count, q.avg_record_count, q.pass_user_num, q.pass_rate, q.fail_user_num, q.fail_rate FROM (SELECT dgrd.dates, dgrd.pkg, dgrd.game_level, COUNT(DISTINCT dgrd.user_id) user_num, COUNT(dgrd.user_id) record_count, COUNT(dgrd.user_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT dgrd.user_id) avg_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE dgrd.game_status WHEN 1 THEN dgrd.user_id END)) pass_user_num, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE dgrd.game_status WHEN 1 THEN dgrd.user_id END)) / COUNT(DISTINCT dgrd.user_id), 8) pass_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT dgrd.user_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE dgrd.game_status WHEN 1 THEN dgrd.user_id END)) fail_user_num, (1 - ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE dgrd.game_status WHEN 1 THEN dgrd.user_id END)) / COUNT(DISTINCT dgrd.user_id), 8)) fail_rate FROM dwd_user_game_record dgrd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui ON (dui.id = dgrd.user_id and dui.dates = dgrd.dates) WHERE dgrd.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dgrd.dates, dgrd.pkg, dgrd.game_level) q LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_game_level dws_pgl ON (dws_pgl.dates = q.dates and dws_pgl.pkg = q.pkg and dws_pgl.game_level = q.game_level)
